blueprint.label: Factory: 1 processing-unit/s, compact
blueprint.description: 7 rows on shelves, products handed over directly. Inputs enter at the bottom of the west bus, west to east: iron-plate 10.1/s, copper-plate 11.3/s, coal 0.889/s; by pipe: petroleum-gas 22.8/s, water 11.7/s. The product leaves at the top. Connect any pole to your grid.
